name: Plank Jack
steps: Set up in a high plank with feet together, palms beneath your shoulders and legs extended.
Brace your abdomen and hop both feet apart, keeping your hands planted.
Hop your feet together and continue opening and closing them rhythmically before lowering your knees to finish.
tips: Keep your hips level as your feet move sideways.
Use a width that lets you land quietly without sagging through your lower back.
